title: Steep
owned: Development testing for online and world on Steep. I worked with programmers, artists and level designers on the Japan DLC map and was responsible for checking event flow and free roam during development, before the map went on to QC. I was also part of the QA team that tested the first version of the four-team multiplayer mode.
brief: Support a new DLC map, the Japan map, through development.
problem: Event flow and free roam had to work while the map was still being built, so that it could go on to QC testing once development finished.
approach: Checked event flow and free roam on the Japan map during development.
result: The Japan map was announced as a free update in the E3 2019 trailer.
reflection: This was a testing role, not a design credit. It is where my eye for edge cases and player flow comes from.
summary: Development tester for online and world on Steep: event flow and free roam on the Japan DLC map, and the first four-team multiplayer mode.
